payload.summary: [Planning Task] Develop CM Plan
payload.description:
1. PM assigns a member to play the role of CC for the project. If the project needs specific IT skill (such as installation, config setting, project server management,...), CC needs to be verified by IT.
2. CC completes CM Plan and sends for review and approval following Fsoft RADIO for Project.
Send requests to IT/ISM for CM Plan review:
- Review Email: CMP.Review@fpt.com
- Email subject: [Project code] – Request review CM Plan
- Attach the latest version of the CM Plan
- Resolved time follows the IT/ISM SLA: 3 working days

3. If the project has any requests for equipment, connection, environment,… assigned member (maybe CC, PTL or PM) sends call-log to related units for support (such as to IT for connection, to Admin for equipment, ISM for security, ...).
4. CM Plan include customer requirements related to security, environment, compliance, and other relevant aspects of the project.

payload.summary: [Planning Task] Study Input Document
payload.description:
1. Collect project documents (NDA, proposal, customer requirement specification...) from AM, SM
2. Upload documents to project repository
3. PM studies obligations on FCMS tool and related documents.
plan
4. PM and team review the contract and related documents to ensure all requirements are understood and reflected in Project. With security requirements in the contract and NDA, PM needs reflect in the project plan, ISM Department needs to review
5. Validate Project & Deliverable Acceptance Criteria defined in the Contract
6. Confirm the acceptance criteria with the customer

payload.summary: [Planning Task] Hold PrePlanning Meeting
payload.description:
The meeting includes, but not limited to:
- Validate the project objectives. 
- Discuss about the project requirements and key deliverables. 
- Discuss about the contract, acceptance criteria
- Discuss and agree on the project approach & processes
- Discuss about the project estimates & schedule.
- Discuss about the project organization
- Discuss about the project training plan
- Discuss about the high-level constraints and assumptions 
- Discuss about the project acceptance criteria
- Discuss about project risks & opportunity
- Discuss any other unrecorded customer or project expectations. 
- Discuss about productivity strategy, goals, actions to improve productivityRequired: 
- A formal meeting must be held for projects ranked A/B/C and first new projects (new product and/or new customer). Required participants of the meeting are: Senior Manager, Operation Manager, PM and QA Representatives, 
- This meeting is optional and could be combined with the project kick-off meeting for project ranked D that are not first new project (new product and/or new customer) or continuous projects 
- Pre-planning meeting can be skipped for very short projects & projects conducted BeGreen

payload.summary: [Planning Task] Hold Project KickOff Meeting
payload.description:
This meeting includes, but not limited to: 
- Project overview, background, customer and project importance, etc.
- Presentation of project deliverable 
- Presentation of project master schedule & plan
- Review and confirm project goals & objectives in term (QPPO) 
- Discuss project dependencies - Discuss project approach & processes, particularly on quality plan, productivity improvement strategy, goals and actions, training plan 
- Discuss on initial project risks & opportunity - Introduce project team, organization structure, role and responsibility - Discuss and confirm communication plan 
- Presentation of project/team evaluation schema together with reward& penalty schema The tasks are: 
1. Prepare kick-off meeting agenda and presentation. 
2. PM share critical obligations of contract, NDA:+ Have contract, NDA before kick-off meeting: PM share in the kick-off meeting or within 25wds from the project started date.+ Haven't enough contract, NDA before kick-off meeting: conduct the sharing contract meeting within 10wds from receiving contract's obligations+ Sharing content: All obligations PM are transferred on FCMS, especially critical obligations
3. Schedule kick-off meeting. 
4. Conduct kick-off meeting. Required participants are :
- Senior Manager/Operation Manager, PM, PTL, QA
- Attendance of higher managment ( HO representative, FSU OM, BU OM) : 
For fixed price project, base on the scale, higher managment joins meeting as bellow: 
a. TCV >= 500.000$: HO Prepresentative 
b. TCV in range of 200,000 USD ~ 500,000 USD : FSU OM c. TCV < 200,000 USD: BU OM
In case higher management has already attended BeGreen meeting, attending Kick off meeting is a nice to have activity

payload.summary: [Planning Task] Develop Detail Schedule
payload.description:
Based on the project's requirement:
1. Convert the project's requirement into work items (Epic => Story/Task/Enabler => Sub-task)
2. Assign work items to members, with corresponding timeline & effort

You can input work items one by one, or you can import the list of work items as guided HERE

payload.summary: [Planning Task] Conduct Start up baseline
payload.description:
1. Perform the baseline according to the CI Baseline procedure defined in the CM Plan.
2. All information describing the current status of CIs and CI revisions will be recorded in Sheet Baseline Report of CM report.
3. Start-up baseline must be conducted within 10 working days after WO 1.0 is approved.
4. An information CI is considered to be baselined when it is in any state in which others can use it.
- Document CIs are baselined after the first version is reviewed and approved for release.
- Source CIs are baselined after the first version reviewed and unit tested
- Customer supplied CIs are baselined at the first time they are received by the project.

payload.summary: [Planning Task] Develop Project Plan (PP) (*)
payload.description:
1.Complete the information required in tab Project plan on FI2.0
2. Review the PP with project team and relevant stakeholder to obtain commitments on the PP. Resolve conflict, if any
3. Obtain final review and approvals required for the PP from the people as defined in FSOFT RADIO
4. Record Project Planning data & information on FI2.0 PM inform criteria for determining project contribution rate.
5. PM confirms implementation of the obligations.
6. All review and approval activities will be recorded directly in FI2.0 where user can see historical change.

payload.summary: [Planning Task] Define Project Productivity
payload.description:
1. Define Project Productivity/ Scopes productivity objective in FI2.0. 
2. Get approval by FSU delivery head within 10 WDs (7 WDs- Very short project) from the Project Planned Start Date
3. Define frequency to measure productivity in Project Plan. Frequency is weekly (recommended) or not longer than milestone periods (mandatory).

payload.summary: [Planning Task] Develop Project Charter (*)
payload.description:
1. Complete the information required in Project Charter on FI2.0, include Project Productivity target approved by FSU delivery head
2. Obtain final review and approvals required for the Project Charter & its associates (Project Estimation, Project Schedule, Project Resource, Project Risk & opportunity) from the people as defined in FSOFT RADIO
3. All review and approval activities will be recorded directly in FI2.0 where user can see historical change.
